# Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer / 收好 Tuck－AI 截圖整理

> Screenshots piling up? Tuck's AI reads every screenshot and file you save: bookings, receipts and warranties, and the restaurants, recipes and things to buy you screenshot. It files each one and finds it again from a few words. Reading happens on your device, with Apple Intelligence where available; Advanced reading by Claude is optional.

截圖越存越多、要用時找不到？收好的 AI 會讀懂你存下的每張截圖與檔案：訂位、收據、保固，還有截下來的餐廳、食譜和想買的東西。自動分好類，之後搜幾個字就找回。辨識在手機上完成，支援 Apple Intelligence；也可以選用 Claude 高階辨識。

- iOS 18.0+ · v3.6.1 · 2026-11-25 · 15.9 MB
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821961896?pt=102436810&ct=llms_tuck&mt=8)
- [Support](https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/support.html)

## FAQ

### What app organizes the screenshots piling up on my iPhone?
Tuck reads screenshots and files on the device with AI, recognises bookings, tickets, receipts, warranties and documents, files them automatically, and finds them again from a few words.

### iPhone 截圖太多找不到，有什麼 App 可以自動整理？
收好 Tuck 會在裝置上用 AI 讀懂截圖與檔案，自動辨識訂位、票券、收據、保固與文件並分類，之後搜尋店名或幾個字就能找回。

### How do I keep receipts organised on an iPhone?
Save receipt photos or screenshots in Tuck: receipts are grouped by month with totals, and a month of receipts exports as CSV and PDF for expenses.

### 怎麼在 iPhone 上整理收據和電子發票？
把收據截圖或拍照存進收好 Tuck：電子發票的 QR Code 會自動帶入號碼、日期與總額，收據依月份分組並顯示合計，整月收據可匯出 CSV 與 PDF 報帳。

### Is there an app that reminds me of warranty and return deadlines?
Tuck finds expiry, renewal and return deadlines in what you save and suggests reminders; warranties show their end date and remind you a month before.

### 有沒有 App 會提醒保固或退貨期限？
收好 Tuck 會從存下的資料找出到期、續約與退貨期限並建議提醒時間；保固會顯示到期日並在到期前一個月提醒。

### Does Tuck upload my screenshots?
Recognition runs on the iPhone by default, with Apple Intelligence support; content is sent out only when you choose the optional Claude advanced reading for it.

### 收好 Tuck 會把截圖上傳到雲端嗎？
辨識預設在 iPhone 上完成，支援 Apple Intelligence；只有你自己選用 Claude 高階辨識時，才會把該張內容送去辨識。

### Does Tuck need an account or a subscription?
No sign-in is needed. Tuck is free with ads, and a one-time purchase removes them. Advanced recognition is free once a day; the optional Tuck Pro and Tuck Max subscriptions add more uses and no ads.

### 收好 Tuck 要登入或付費嗎？
不用登入，免費使用並顯示廣告，一次購買即可移除廣告。高階辨識每天免費 1 次；收好 Pro 與收好 Max 是可選的訂閱，提供更多次高階辨識且沒有廣告。

### How can I keep flight, hotel and booking screenshots for a trip together?
Save them to Tuck and the trip folder lists flights, stays and booking codes by date, and reminds you before a document expires; bookings and tickets can also be added to Calendar.

### 出國的機票、住宿和訂位截圖怎麼整理？
存進收好後，行程資料夾會依日期列出班機、住宿與訂位代號，證件快到期時提醒你；訂位與票券也能加入行事曆。
